alignments.note: Presentative הָיָה frame; the apodosis waw s010 carries the *that* (rule 45).
כַּאֲשֶׁר fused → when, headed on the opening morpheme (rule 23).
Apodosis waw takes the *that* written at the apodosis head (rule 45).
Explicit pronoun takes only its own I (rule 20).
Supplied *a* belongs to the construct noun (rule 15).
Article on the rectum; ASV writes *a house of cedar* with no *the* (rule 29).
Middle construct takes *of* and a supplied *the* (rules 19, 29).

Prepositional predicate takes the construction's copula (rule 49); *dwelleth* asserts the ark's continuance under curtains, so read as a copula of the *remain* kind under rule 20 rather than an added lexical verb. Competing reading: *dwelleth* added.

review_notes: The italic *dwelleth* was read as a construction copula on תַּחַת; the added reading is the competitor.

alignments.note: Article on God; ASV writes no *the* (rule 29).

ASV writes the temporal phrase bare, *the same night* (rule 40).

Dative לְ rendered as bare indirect object *me* (rule 40).
Article present but ASV writes *a house*; the *a* is the noun's (rule 15/29).
*dwell in*: the *in* is the English verb's own reach (rule 44).
Hiphil → brought up; particle completes the lexeme (rule 44).
ASV *have gone* for הָיָה; margin *Hebrew have been* read and set aside (rule 38).
Supplied contrastive determiner *one* joins the noun (rule 15).
*to another*: supplied preposition and supplied noun, one added unit (rules 2, 33).

Repeated לְ before the appositive; ASV writes none (rule 40).
Margin *Or, pasture* read and set aside (rule 38).
Infinitive takes supplied subject and modal (rule 52).
בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר → whithersoever, one word for three morphemes (rule 30/35); no morpheme's lexeme is written in particular, so the first token is the display anchor (rule 6). Competing head: s006.
מִפְּנֵי → from before: a word for each, so split (rule 30).
Construct takes a supplied *the*; the rectum is rendered arthrously (rule 29).
Article takes the *the* before its own word (rule 29).
Substantival adjective with supplied generic *ones*; rectum's *of* (rules 19, 31).
waw rendered by the subordinator *that* (rule 14, open list).
תַּחַת → in ... place: fixed phrase, headed on the content word (rule 24); discontinuous around the suffix.
Emphatic possessive *their own* belongs to the suffix (rule 18).
waw + לֹא → neither, headed on the negative (rule 35).
יָסַף as auxiliary rendered *any more*, keeping the finite verb's auxiliary *shall* (rule 56).
לְ before the infinitive; ASV writes the bare verb *waste* (rule 52/40).

Compound לְמִן rendered *as from*; fused, headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23), target on the relational word. Competing reading: לְ → *as* and מִן → *from* split, or *as* added as the italic suggests (rule 7).
Prepositional predicate takes the supplied *to be* frame (rule 49).

review_notes: The italic *as* was fused with the מִן as the rendering of לְמִן rather than marked added; see the unit note.

alignments.note: Presentative frame; the apodosis *that* (t021) goes to waw s012 (rule 45).
לְ + infinitive recast finite; preposition takes the complementizer (rule 52).
Infinitive takes supplied subject and modal (rule 52).
Prepositional predicate takes the *to be* copula frame (rule 49).
Resultative הָיָה לְ; copula on the verb (rule 21).
Hiphil סוּר → take ... away; the particle completes the lexeme (rule 44), discontinuous around the object.
Compound מֵעִם → from, headed on the first morpheme (rule 23).
Supplied object *it*; no object morpheme on the verb (rule 44).
Article on עוֹלָם; ASV writes *for ever* with no *the* (rule 29).
Auxiliary *did* with the verb, discontinuous around the subject (rule 17).
בּוֹא → went in; the particle completes the lexeme (rule 44).
מִי is the predicate and takes the copula (rule 20).
Predicate מִי → what, with the copula (rule 20).
עַד־הֲלֹם → thus far; an idiom rendered as a pair no morpheme owns a part of; headed on the adverb carrying the content (rule 23).
Stative verb קָטֹן rendered *was a small thing*; the generic *a thing* completes the predicate and is kept with the verb, headed on *small* (rule 31). Competing reading: *a thing* added.
Possessive recasting; construct keeps its own word (rule 29).
The outer לְ independently supplies for. Removing for removes this outer temporal relation while leaving the distant-future expression intact; rules 2 and 11 favor separating it.

מִן + רָחוֹק jointly renders a great while to come under rule 30. No preferable allocation gives מִן an independent prospective to come. Great carries the distance lexeme; while is the supplied temporal category and the competing head under rule 31.
Rectum rendered indefinitely, *a man*; article unrepresented (rule 29).
Rectum takes *of*; *a* is the noun's own (rules 15, 19).
Article on מַעֲלָה; ASV writes no *the* (rule 29).
Appositive noun with supplied *of* (rule 33); *high degree* headed on *degree*, the ASV's ordinary word for מַעֲלָה (rule 31); *high* is the competing head.
יָסַף as auxiliary rendered *more*, keeping the finite verb's modal *can* (rule 56); the lexical verb *say* is supplied.
Supplied lexical verb *say*; no morpheme in the clause carries it (rule 20).
Supplied relative and lexical verb *which is done*, one added run (rule 2).
Marker on a nominal the ASV construes as an adjunct takes the *to* written for it (rule 16).
בְּ → for and עֲבוּר → sake have independently recoverable English renderings; split under rules 2 and 11 rather than fusing under rule 30.
Emphatic possessive *thine own* belongs to the suffix (rule 18).
Article rendered by the demonstrative *these* (rule 41); the italic corroborates and decides nothing (rule 7).
Existential אַיִן heads on the negation (rule 50).
waw + אַיִן → neither is there, one fusion headed on the negative (rules 35, 50).
מִי → what; the copula goes to the prepositional predicate (rule 49).
Margin's alternative rendering read and set aside (rule 38).
Bare nominal takes the supplied *by* (rule 33); substantival adjective.
Supplied generic *things* closes the coordinated substantives and joins the last (rules 22, 31).
מִפְּנֵי → from before: a word for each (rule 30).
נָתַן → make, with fronted auxiliary and subject (rule 17).
Dative לְ recast as possessive *thine own* (rule 40).
Emphatic possessive belongs to the suffix (rule 18).
Jussive frame *let ... be established* belongs to the verb (rule 17), discontinuous around the subject.
Jussive frame *let ... be established* belongs to the verb (rule 17); margin's alternative set aside (rule 38).
יִגְדַּל → magnified, sharing the first verb's frame.
Predicate construct noun takes the copula and a supplied *the* (rules 20, 29).
Appositional *even* before a phrase no marker stands on (rule 16).
Vocative with supplied *O* (rule 36), discontinuous around the possessive.

גָּלָה אֹזֶן forms the disclosure idiom rendered hast revealed. The ear participates in that verbal meaning rather than being an independently omitted object. Its marker alone intervenes; no independent subject or object breaks the lexical expression. Head on גָּלָה, whose lexeme revealed writes. The alternative retains a silent ear.
Retain to on the marker of the recast object under rule 16: it expresses the recipient relation through which revealed reaches the servant.
The suffix takes thy under rule 18.
לְ + infinitive recast finite; preposition takes the complementizer (rule 52).
Infinitive takes supplied subject and modal (rule 52).
עַל־כֵּן → therefore, headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23).
Supplied phrase *in his heart*; preposition, possessive and noun all unlicensed, one added unit (rules 2, 33).
Resuming pronoun of a tripartite clause rendered by nothing but the copula, which goes to the predicate (rule 20).
Impersonal recasting *it hath pleased thee*: the dummy and the demoted subject both realize the verb's own person (rule 44).
Supplied *the* on the construct (rule 29); the *it* of *it is blessed* resumes this noun in a later verbless clause (rule 25). Competing reading: that *it* added.
Rectum takes *of* (rule 19), discontinuous around the possessive.
Infinitive takes supplied subject and modal (rule 52); *continue* renders הָיָה.
